events.title: Fractional factorial completed and reported
events.detail: 128 fits (16 runs x draws 14-15 x 4 folds, 1276.5 s). Supported inclusion effects under the frozen rule: B (DEM curvature/scarp, +0.0241, 8/8 cells positive) and E (visible-catalogue geometry, +0.0596, 8/8); supported interactions AC, AD, CD positive and AB, BD negative. C (strain/seismicity) is negative but its worst cells breach the -0.010 stability floor, so the frozen rule refuses to certify it.
